_source: Design values settled by review/01-huawei-solar.md, 02-construction.md, 03-electrical.md and the Investor's site corrections in 05-site-corrections.md. Dimensions in mm.

support.bom: custom-fabricated (off-catalogue on wind grounds, see wind.verdict) — Huawei Standard A-shaped 3.0 geometry conventions reused for margins/overhang only
support.anchor_bom: M16-M20 resin anchor, site-specific (karst limestone), not a Huawei part
support.source: review/07-calculations.md F.6 (2026-08-08) — rederived from PVM p.80 Table 3-29 / p.180 Table 4-20 conventions for a custom 2-column crossbeam; frame mass is an estimate pending the fabricator's calc

wind.verdict: No catalogue tilt is compliant; tender requires certified site-specific static calculation pre-award.
wind.note: 3x4 (2 rows x 2 columns) adopted 2026-08-08 in place of 2x6: sail area per support drops from 15.91 to 10.55 m2 (-34%, not the -50% the BOQ OPCIJA text assumed). The freed wind budget was spent raising bottom_edge from 500 to 1500 mm so overturning per support (62.8 kNm) stays at/below the old 2x6 design's 64.3 kNm; uplift (18.1 kN) is well under the old 27.3 kN since it is height-independent.

foundation.note: Depth and reinforcement to be confirmed by the bidder's certified calculation for qp >= 1.20 kN/m2. 3 supports (was 2) = 6 strips total, one extra foundation pair + anchor set vs the 2x6 design.

genset.alternator: FG Wilson FGL10060, SHUNT excitation, IP23, class H
genset._source: FG Wilson P22-6(Skid) technical data sheet, 2019-08-14 — EQUIPEMENT/GENSET/P22-6_FG_Wilson_full_datasheet_2019-08-14.pdf. Supersedes the 3-page web printout that carried no dimensions or weights.

tank._source: FG Wilson 500 l indoor tank data supplied by the Investor 2026-08-11: 1050L x 600W x 1310H, 170 kg. Supersedes the earlier unverified 1200x700x800 estimate; full mass = 170 kg + 500 l diesel @ ~0.84 = ~590 kg over 0.63 m2 = 9.2 kN/m2.

bund.basis: >=110 % of 500 l = 550 l; 1.70 m2 x 0.33 m = 560 l (BOQ 4.3, 03-electrical Y-14). Tank 1050x600 sits inside with 275/230 mm margins.

ventilation.duct: limeni kanal ≈6 m² od radijatora do izlazne žaluzine

layout.intake_wall: JUG - istocni kraj (x 2150-2650), donja ivica +300 mm od poda
layout.discharge_wall: ZAPAD - limeni kanal pravo od radijatora kroz zid, zaluzina 600x600 na osi radijatora
layout.exhaust: ZAPAD - flex + prigusivac, uspon uz zapadni zid, zavrsetak iznad krova sa hvatacem iskri
layout.room_fan_wall: ISTOK - gore (donja ivica +1750 mm), sjeverno od vrata
layout.tank_vent_wall: SJEVER - istocni kraj, >=3 m prostorno od izduva i usisa
layout._rationale: Cross-flow SE->W closes EL RED-03: previous layout put intake, discharge AND exhaust on the NORTH wall 1.4 m apart, next to the outdoor ICC330-H1/MTS9302 cabinets, with the tank standing in front of the intake. Now intake (S) and discharge/exhaust (W) are on opposite airflow ends, nothing discharges toward the cabinets, and the tank+bund sit clear on the NORTH wall.

ventilation._verdict: The tendered arrangement is ADEQUATE. Intake 500x700 gives 3.4 m/s and ~16 Pa; discharge 600x600 gives ~15 Pa; with the duct the total stays well inside the manufacturer's 125 Pa external-restriction budget. The 1200 m3/h axial fan is a supplementary room-ventilation fan (stated minimum 120 m3/h = 6 ACH), not the cooling path — the radiator's own fan moves the 1980 m3/h. DN50 exhaust meets the 10.2 kPa back-pressure limit (~2.6 kPa) but runs at 33 m/s; DN65 is recommended to stay under the customary 30 m/s.
ventilation._source: Computed from the manufacturer data sheet; supersedes the estimates in 03-electrical.md RED-01/RED-04.

container._height_note: Per the container type sheet; 02-construction Y-05 lists conflicting heights (2.40/2.80/2.89 m) - confirm on the mandatory site visit.
container.floor_note: Floor designed for a total (g+p) UDL of 10.00 kN/m2 - certified project of this K2 object, '04 AG dio.docx' 4.4.2.3 (secondary beams HOP 100x50x3 at 0.51 m, 5.10 kN/m'; primary 15.00 kN/m'). The 2.00 kN/m2 in the same project is the pedestrian live load on the walkable strip only. Genset wet 385 kg over 0.96 m2 = 3.93 kN/m2; full 500 l tank 590 kg over 0.63 m2 = 9.2 kN/m2; combined 975 kg. Both sit under 10.00 kN/m2 but act as concentrated loads on a few secondary beams, so a load-spreading grillage/frame under BOTH the skid and the bund is REQUIRED - to distribute onto the primary beams, not because capacity is exceeded.

access.verdict: FITS — 620 mm skid through a 900 mm door leaves 280 mm; height 1020 mm against a 2000 mm door. No roof panel removal or wall opening needed.
